issues.description: The template Main.java uses a different method name for feeding the farm than the problem specification and the solution. The commented example in the template calls farm.feed(), while the problem statement and the solution expect feedAllAnimals(). This naming mismatch can confuse students when they try to run or follow the example in Main and may lead them to implement or look for the wrong method name.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Main.java example to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (or change all references in problem and solution to use farm.feed()) so the example, specification, and solution consistently use the same method name. Prefer updating the template to farm.feedAllAnimals() to match the specification.
